Title: VDA 55006
Description: Label for VDA 55006 with size A5(210*148mm) using action ZHU_VDA_FORMS
Condition To Print: The labels gets triggered upon HU weigh update

Additional Info.Printer: Printer is determined from condition record
Additional Info.Details:
1. Condition record maintained with reference to work center and ship-to party.
2. When entry is maintained in Table ZT0430 with Ship-to party, the Delivery number is truncated to the last 8 characters.
